    Fischbacher §5.3: the key fact and the case of a common first arrow #

    For a good walk and a segment with valley c, no vertex of the walk outside that segment lies below c (ZWalk.Good.key), and on the segment only c does. This is the fact (K) behind Fischbacher's §5.3: after the segment is replaced, c leaves the convex hull.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.ZSeg.eq_of_reaches_c {A : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} A] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms A] [IsRayCategory A] (hcf : ∀ (x : A) (p : Quiver.Path (RayVert.mk x) (RayVert.mk x)), p.length = 0) {σ : ZSeg A} {u : A} (hu : u ∈ σ.verts) (hr : Reaches u σ.c) :
